title: Azure OpenAI Service Integration in .NET
description: Deploy and integrate enterprise Azure OpenAI models in C# using Azure.AI.OpenAI, deployment topologies, and Managed Identity.

data.text: While OpenAI's public API provides access to the same foundational weights, enterprise organizations require corporate governance, data sovereignty, regulatory compliance (HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001), and integration with existing cloud identity boundaries. Azure OpenAI guarantees that customer prompts and completions are never used to train or improve any OpenAI model, processes data within designated geographic regions, and integrates with Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) and private virtual networks.

data.text: Connecting via Azure.AI.OpenAI and Managed Identity
The Azure OpenAI client library is built directly atop the official OpenAI .NET client, exposing AzureOpenAIClient which accepts an Azure endpoint URI and a TokenCredential from Azure.Identity.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Azure OpenAI provides identical GPT intelligence backed by Microsoft's enterprise SLA and compliance guarantees
Prompts and completions in Azure OpenAI are never retained for model retraining
Reference deployments by deployment name rather than raw model IDs
Use DefaultAzureCredential for passwordless, zero-secret authentication in production
The Azure.AI.OpenAI SDK inherits all ChatClient capabilities from the official OpenAI .NET library
data.takeaway: Azure OpenAI delivers enterprise-grade LLM capabilities to .NET applications, blending OpenAI models with Azure security, private networking, and managed identity.
